changes.zh: 在模型请求进行中退出或重启 EasyICU（包括正常退出）、程序崩溃或断电后，EasyICU 会在确认之前的工作进程已不存在、且超过该请求的超时时间后，自动释放被占用的模型请求名额；以前这会让之后的每次请求都被拒绝，只能手动移走状态文件。
changes.en: After EasyICU is quit or restarted during a model request (also normally), crashes or loses power, EasyICU now frees the held model-request slot on its own once the earlier worker has verifiably ended and the request's timeout has passed. Before, every later request was refused until the state file was moved aside by hand.

changes.zh: 「之前的模型请求仍占用可用容量」的提示现在直接写明恢复办法：退出 EasyICU，把 ~/.easyicu/metadata-provider-slots.sqlite3 移到别处（保留文件，不要删除），再重新启动；之前那次请求可能仍在运行。
changes.en: The "earlier model request still occupies the allowed capacity" stop now says how to continue: quit EasyICU, move ~/.easyicu/metadata-provider-slots.sqlite3 aside (keep the file, do not delete it) and start again; the earlier request may still have been running.

changes.zh: 0.1.3 的已知问题仍然适用，完整列表见 v0.1.3 发布说明。
changes.en: The known issues of 0.1.3 still apply; the full list is in the v0.1.3 release notes.

changes.zh: 用于探索研究问题，每个结果都需要您自己核对；不要用于发表或临床决策。
changes.en: Use v0.1.4 to explore questions and check every result yourself; do not use it for publication or clinical decisions.

changes.zh: 选择首次 ICU 入住时要求排序明确，时间冲突的入住会被拒绝而不是猜测；在 MIMIC 上指数据库记录内的首次入住，提取、规划和运行使用同一规则。
changes.en: First ICU stay selection requires an unambiguous ordering; conflicting stays are refused instead of guessed. On MIMIC it means the first stay within the database's record, and extraction, planning and the run apply the same rule.

changes.zh: 字典更新：新增可选概念（如 FiO2 设置、肾脏病史）；eICU 输注速率不再计入速率为零的小时；SICdb 不记录 GCS，相关 SOFA-2 和 Sepsis-3（SOFA-2）概念标为不可用。
changes.en: Dictionary updates: new opt-in concepts (for example FiO2 settings and renal history); eICU infusion rates no longer count zero-rate hours; SICdb, which records no GCS, marks the affected SOFA-2 and Sepsis-3 (SOFA-2) concepts unavailable.

changes.zh: 早期转换的 MIMIC-III 在 services 表损坏时改读原始 CSV；所选模块没有数据行时导出为空表而不是报错。
changes.en: An older MIMIC-III conversion with a damaged services table reads the original CSV, and a selected module with no rows exports as an empty table instead of failing.

changes.zh: 要求的交付物（稿件 PDF、文章预览、参考文献）在计划卡片上可编辑，运行只产出确认的那些，未产出的会点名说明。只有交付物包含参考文献时才写出 .bib 文件。
changes.en: Requested deliverables (manuscript PDF, article preview, references) are an editable list on the plan card; the run produces exactly the confirmed set and names any omission. A .bib file is written only when references are a confirmed deliverable.

changes.zh: 基于官方演示原始数据的研究：已确认的数据源选择会保留；首次入住、landmark 和数据准备不再在中途停止；在对话中请求本研究的提取会真正开始提取；直接绑定官方演示原始文件夹、从未选择过数据源的研究，会得到首次数据源选择，而不再停在无法继续的卡片上。
changes.en: Studies on the official Demo's raw data keep a confirmed source choice, no longer stop midway on first-stay, landmark or data-preparation checks, and asking in the conversation for the study's extraction now starts it; a study bound straight to the official Demo raw folder with no earlier source choice is offered that first choice instead of a card that cannot continue.

changes.zh: 计划和数据准备卡片在无法继续时会说明原因并给出下一步，不再出现没有按钮或没有失败说明的卡片。
changes.en: Plan and data-preparation cards that cannot continue say why and offer a next step; no card is left without buttons or a failure line.

changes.zh: 问题限定了人群（如「在脓毒症 ICU 患者中」）时，计划必须对它作出回应：没有按它筛选的计划会退回重写，无法应用的条件会在计划卡片上标为未应用。人群条件只有出现在问题中的文字才算研究本身陈述的条件。在已准备的导出上，计划现在可以自行写出这些人群条件；计划没有按条件筛选，或研究设置记录的“不限定人群”与问题矛盾时，方案卡片都会说明。一个你已接受为未应用的人群条件（如「成人 ICU 患者」），在分析执行时会保留在计划、报告和论文中；按已记录条件（如脓毒症）筛选的研究，在准备数据时会保持已批准的人群。问题限定为脓毒症、急性肾损伤或机械通气，而计划两次都没有写出或施加该条件时，系统按题面补入（相应记录在入科 0–24 小时内出现，无法判定者排除），方案卡片注明“人群条件由系统按题面补入”，可用「修改人群」更改。计划只引用题面和你自己的表述作为人群条件；你的表述没有要求、数据也无法核实的“每次住院的首次 ICU 入住”限制会在下一次规划前去掉，并在方案卡片上注明，在「提出修改」中要求去掉首次入住限制也会真正去掉。
changes.en: When the question restricts its patients (for example to septic ICU patients), the plan must answer for it: a plan that does not select on it goes back to be rewritten, and a condition that cannot be applied is shown as not applied. Only words in the question count as the study's own population conditions. On a prepared export the plan can now state such a condition itself, and the plan card says so when the plan selects on it nowhere or when a recorded choice to take every patient contradicts the question. A population condition you accepted as not applied (for example adult ICU patients) stays in the executed plan, report and paper, and a study selected on a recorded condition such as sepsis keeps its approved population when its data are prepared. When the question restricts its patients to sepsis, AKI or mechanical ventilation and the plan twice leaves the condition out or does not apply it, the system adds it from the question (the condition recorded in ICU hours 0–24, unknown values excluded); the plan card says the system added it, and Change cohort changes it. A plan quotes only the question and your own wording as the population: a first-ICU-stay-per-hospitalization restriction that no wording of yours states and the data cannot verify is taken off before the next plan and the plan card says so, and asking in Request changes to remove a first-stay restriction removes it.

changes.zh: 暴露分组：两组暴露加 24 小时 landmark 不再被拒绝；模型说错分组概念时会重问一次，仍失败则如实说明是规划出错，并指向重新生成计划。
changes.en: Exposure groupings: a two-group exposure with a 24-hour landmark is no longer refused, and when the model names a wrong grouping concept it is asked once more; a second failure is reported as a planning error with "Generate a fresh plan".

changes.zh: 在计划审阅中选择暴露安排（例如“仅分析主要暴露”）后，EasyICU 会记录这一选择，修订后的计划不会再问同一个问题。问题写明暴露的取值方式（如“入科时首次乳酸”）时，研究设置不会再存成另一种（如 24 小时最高值）。
changes.en: After you choose an exposure arrangement in plan review (for example "Analyse only the primary exposure"), EasyICU records the choice and the revised plan no longer asks again. When the question states how the exposure is summarized (for example the first lactate at ICU admission), the study can no longer store a different summary such as the 24-hour maximum.

changes.zh: 暴露按首 24 小时判定而结局不是院内死亡的计划，会先问时间对齐，只给出能运行的选项。
changes.en: A plan whose exposure is read over the first 24 hours with an outcome other than in-hospital death asks the timing question and offers only choices that can run.

changes.zh: 模型服务短暂故障会重试两次；连接中断、登录过期和切换连接都有明确提示，运行使用对话中选定的模型。
changes.en: Brief model-service faults are retried twice; dropped connections, expired sign-ins and connection switches are named clearly, and runs use the model selected in the conversation.

changes.zh: 首轮结果卡片上的"扩展成完整论文"现在会准备论文级分析扩展供审阅（0.1.3 中不生成稿件），只在结果可以扩展时显示；已执行的基线关联研究现在能正确登记为扩展来源，登记失败时结果卡片会说明原因，并在下次打开时重试；记录了新版研究上下文的结果也可以扩展。
changes.en: "Extend to a full article" on a first-result card now prepares paper-level analyses for review (in 0.1.3 it writes no manuscript), and appears only when the result can take one; a finished baseline association study is now recorded as its source correctly, and if that fails the result card says why and tries again the next time it opens; results whose run recorded a newer research context can be extended too.

changes.zh: 在准备数据和批准计划之间重启 EasyICU 后，批准的分析可以正常运行；研究者已确认暴露的 landmark 关联研究也可以正常生成候选计划。
changes.en: An analysis approved after EasyICU was restarted between data preparation and approval now runs, and a landmark association study whose exposure you confirmed can generate its candidate plan.

changes.zh: Idea Mining 不再把研究人群或调整变量当作暴露或预测因子；候选方向列出后会等您选择。
changes.en: Idea Mining no longer takes the studied population or an adjustment covariate as the exposure or predictor, and waits for you to choose a direction.

changes.zh: 分析运行镜像改用 duckdb 1.5.6，与发布测试所用版本一致。
changes.en: The analysis runner image uses duckdb 1.5.6, the version the release tests ran under.

changes.zh: 已知问题：自动编译后若要求确认数据源，点击一次即可继续；问题限定人群时，EasyICU 能按条件筛选的只有脓毒症（Sepsis-3）、急性肾损伤（AKI）和机械通气（数据中有相应记录而计划未写出或只写了未施加时，由系统按题面补入并在方案卡片上注明），其他人群（如心衰、ARDS、创伤）会在方案卡片上提示，请在方案审阅中确认人群条件已列出；若方案卡片提示计划没有回答题面要求，请点击「重新生成计划」；若方案卡片要求明确人群条件的判定方式，请在对话中说明无法判定的入住如何计入，再重新生成计划（计划在 0.1.5 提供列明的默认处理）；需要论文、PDF 和参考文献时，请在提问时就要求写成论文（论文需要 Docker 加 EasyICU 运行镜像；没有 Docker 时只给出表格和图形的首轮结果）；首轮结果的「扩展成完整论文」在 0.1.3 只补充论文级分析，不生成稿件；出现「再确认一次数据源」时请用「按本研究人群准备数据」，「确认数据源并继续」只会按元数据重新规划；第一次点「重新生成计划」没有反应时，刷新后再点一次；本机运行中，只有暴露在基线（入科时）取值的关联研究可以扩展首轮结果；暴露按首 24 小时取值的研究通常以 24 小时 landmark 设计运行，暂不能扩展（计划在 0.1.5 支持）；简单的描述性问题有时会被规划成完整研究，并因「论文图需要至少两个有数据的分面」而停止；请把它作为一个直接的数值问题来问（例如「这份数据里……的中位数是多少？」），EasyICU 会给出快速回答卡片（是否符合快速回答由系统按问题判断）；刚刷新页面后，「使用这份数据」偶尔会失败并出现「权威状态已变化」横幅，点击「重新绑定当前状态」后再选一次「使用这份数据」即可。完整列表见发布说明。
changes.en: Known issues: if an automatically compiled plan asks to confirm the data source, one click continues; when your question restricts the population, EasyICU selects only for sepsis (Sepsis-3), AKI and mechanical ventilation (when the data record the condition and the plan leaves it out or only names it, the system adds it from the question and the plan card says so), and other populations (for example heart failure, ARDS, trauma) are flagged on the plan card, so check in plan review that the population condition is listed; if the plan card says the plan does not answer something the question asks, click Generate fresh plan; if the plan card asks how to apply a population criterion, say in the conversation how stays where it cannot be determined count, then generate a fresh plan (a listed default is planned for 0.1.5); for a paper with its PDF and references, ask for a paper in your question (a paper needs Docker with the EasyICU runner image; without Docker you get first-round tables and figures only); in 0.1.3 "Extend to a full article" on a first result adds paper-level analyses only and writes no manuscript; on "Confirm the data source again" use "Prepare data for this cohort", since "Confirm the data source and continue" only plans again from metadata; if the first click on Generate fresh plan does nothing, reload and click again; on the local runner, only association studies whose exposure is taken at baseline (ICU admission) can extend a first result; studies whose exposure is read over the first 24 hours usually run as a 24-hour landmark design and cannot yet be extended (planned for 0.1.5); a simple descriptive question may be planned as a full study and then stop because a manuscript figure needs at least two data-backed panels; ask it as one direct numerical question about the selected data (for example "what is the median … in this data?"), which EasyICU answers with a quick-answer card (the system decides per question whether it qualifies); right after a page load, "Use this data" may fail with an "Authority changed" banner: click "Rebind current state", then choose "Use this data" again. See the release notes for the full list.

changes.zh: 用于探索研究问题，每个结果都需要您自己核对；不要用于发表或临床决策。
changes.en: Use v0.1.3 to explore questions and check every result yourself; do not use it for publication or clinical decisions.

changes.zh: 硬件要求：MIMIC-IV 规模的数据库建议 16 GB 内存，4 核约 70 分钟；14 GB 也能完成，但会触发一次内存不足后的自动减半重试。eICU 需要高内存服务器：4 个 worker 不限内存时峰值约 88 GiB，限制在 32 GB 时可完成但有 3 次自动重试。各库 4 个 worker 不限内存时的峰值：MIMIC-IV 19.4、AUMC 17.4、HiRID 17.6、eICU 87.7、SICdb 7.4、MIMIC-III 14.5 GiB。14 GB 内的优化留到 0.1.1。
changes.en: Hardware: MIMIC-IV-scale databases need 16 GB RAM and take about 70 minutes on 4 cores; 14 GB also completes, after one automatic halve-on-out-of-memory retry. eICU needs a high-memory server: about 88 GiB peak with 4 workers and no memory cap; under a 32 GB cap it completes with 3 automatic retries. Peak memory per database with 4 workers and no cap: MIMIC-IV 19.4, AUMC 17.4, HiRID 17.6, eICU 87.7, SICdb 7.4, MIMIC-III 14.5 GiB. Fitting within 14 GB is planned for 0.1.1.

changes.zh: 概念缓存的标识包含计算代码本身；升级后旧版本写入的缓存不再被复用，会重新计算。
changes.en: The concept cache key now includes the computing code, so after an upgrade a cache written by an older version is recomputed instead of reused.

changes.zh: 数据转换中途取消后，重新扫描或重启应用仍显示为未完成，不会误判为可以分析；继续转换完成后才变为就绪。
changes.en: A data conversion cancelled midway stays incomplete after a rescan or restart instead of being reported ready for analysis; it becomes ready once a resumed conversion finishes.

changes.zh: 模型服务返回错误且响应缓慢时，应用的其他请求不再被卡住。
changes.en: A slow error response from the model service no longer stalls the app's other requests.

changes.zh: 发给写作模型的证据和人群筛选计数中，1 到 10 的小计数一律隐去，也无法再由总数、比例或筛选链上的其他计数反推出来。
changes.en: Counts of 1 to 10 are withheld from the evidence and the selection counts sent to the writing model, and can no longer be recovered from published totals, rates or the other counts in the selection chain.

changes.zh: 论文正文里的数字只有在句子写明了对应的变量、统计量、单位和组别时，才会绑定到同类型的结果；含糊时不再绑定到错误的结果。
changes.en: A number in the manuscript text binds to a result of the same kind only when the sentence names its variable, statistic, unit and group; ambiguous numbers are no longer bound to the wrong result.

changes.zh: 尿量 12 小时间隔判定对时间平移不敏感：恰好 12 小时保留，多 1 秒判为间断。
changes.en: The 12-hour urine gap rule no longer depends on the absolute clock: exactly 12 hours is kept, 1 second more is a gap.

changes.zh: 命令行遇到常见输入问题时给出一行可操作的英文提示并以退出码 2 结束：需要授权的数据库不再尝试下载（请从 PhysioNet 手动下载后转换），未准备好的目录提示先运行转换；easyicu-llm-server --help 不再要求先设置密钥。
changes.en: The command line answers common input problems with one actionable English line and exit code 2: credentialed databases are no longer downloaded (download them from PhysioNet, then convert), an unprepared directory asks you to run the converter first, and easyicu-llm-server --help no longer requires a key.

changes.zh: 命令行 easyicu extract 在数据库被跳过或没有导出任何行时返回非零退出码。
changes.en: The easyicu extract command exits non-zero when a requested database is skipped or yields no rows.

changes.zh: 可选导出模块 weight_strict 提供入 ICU 时可知的单次体重及其来源和时间，原有 weight 不变。
changes.en: The opt-in weight_strict export module gives one stay weight known at ICU admission, with its source and time; the existing weight is unchanged.

changes.zh: 生成计划前先请你确认系统提议的主要结局；确认卡直接保存你确认的结局。
changes.en: Before the plan is drafted, you confirm the proposed primary outcome; the card saves the outcome you confirm.

changes.zh: eICU、HiRID 无法确定同一患者跨住院的首次 ICU 入住时，会先说明并给出替代口径（每次住院的首次入住，或全部入住按患者聚类），人群卡写明口径。
changes.en: When eICU or HiRID cannot order a patient's stays across hospitalizations, a per-patient first-stay request is answered up front with alternatives (first stay per hospitalization, or all stays clustered by patient), and the population card states the scope.

changes.zh: 数据能按患者分组时，第一版计划直接按患者聚类处理重复入住，不再连跑两次计划。
changes.en: When the data groups stays by patient, the first plan already clusters repeated stays by patient, so a second plan no longer follows.

changes.zh: 点结果数字可看到对比组、参照组、样本量、单位、时间界标和调整变量。
changes.en: Tracing a result number shows its contrast, reference, sample, unit, landmark and adjustment.

changes.zh: 论文正文按变量名称书写对比（如 lactate），不再出现 lact max 这类内部列名。
changes.en: Article sentences name variables by their labels (for example lactate) instead of internal column names such as lact max.

changes.zh: 不支持一键追加的结果只显示一行说明，不再列出点不了的选项；下一步建议去重。
changes.en: Results that cannot take one-click additions show one line instead of options that cannot run; next-step choices are deduplicated.

changes.zh: 修正时间网格补齐时观测越界写入下一位患者的问题，少量 SOFA 总分随之更正。
changes.en: Gap filling no longer writes an observation past one patient's grid into the next patient; a few SOFA totals change accordingly.

changes.zh: 新增 NWICU、浙江 eICU、金华、自贡四个社区 ICU 数据源（仅映射）；修正 MIMIC-III/IV 与 AUMC 的葡萄糖、血氧、氧分压、尿量和入量取数，新增 FiO2/PEEP 来源通道。
changes.en: Adds four community ICU sources (NWICU, Zhejiang eICU, Jinhua, Zigong; mapping only); corrects dextrose, oxygen saturation, PaO2, urine and fluid-input mappings for MIMIC-III/IV and AUMC, and adds FiO2/PEEP source channels.

changes.zh: 对话侧栏按任务列出：待你处理的单独成组，最近的在前，可打开全部任务表搜索和筛选。
changes.en: The conversation rail lists tasks: those waiting for you are grouped first, recent ones follow, and a full task table can be searched and filtered.

changes.zh: 项目成果里，被当前计划取代、没跑到分析的早期尝试会收起，不再一条条标红。
changes.en: In project results, early attempts superseded by the current plan that never reached an analysis are folded instead of listed in red.

changes.zh: 研究可以使用无呼吸机天数等“存活且无事件天数”、有序结局和计数结局。
changes.en: Studies can use free-day outcomes such as ventilator-free days, ordinal outcomes and count outcomes.

changes.zh: 新增跨库外部验证、各数据库效应的 REML 合并、g-方法（MSM 与单时点 g-formula）和重复测量的混合模型与 GEE。
changes.en: Adds cross-database external validation, REML pooling of per-database effects, g-methods (MSM and point g-formula) and mixed models and GEE for repeated measures.

changes.zh: 支持多重插补并按 Rubin 规则合并；数据预处理（异常值、时间窗汇总、单位统一、缺失处理、标准化）在计划中逐项可见。
changes.en: Supports multiple imputation pooled by Rubin's rules; data preparation (outliers, window aggregation, units, missing data, scaling) is listed step by step in the plan.

changes.zh: 在输入框输入 / 可以直接选用技能。
changes.en: Typing / in the composer picks a skill directly.

changes.zh: 设置中可选择数据和项目的存放位置；桌面版用系统钥匙串记住模型密钥。
changes.en: Settings choose where data and projects are stored; the desktop app remembers model keys in the system keychain.

changes.zh: 技能中心各页统一标题与操作；技能可以打包导入导出。
changes.en: Skill Hub tabs share one header and actions; skills can be imported and exported as packages.

changes.zh: 新增 MIMIC-III 官方演示数据，可以在旧版 MIMIC 结构上从抽取一直做到出图。
changes.en: Adds the official MIMIC-III demo, so the whole path from extraction to figures also runs on the older MIMIC structure.

changes.zh: 在对话侧栏点搜索，可以查找所有项目里的对话、计划、结果和文件，点开直接到对应的位置。
changes.en: Search from the conversation rail finds conversations, plans, results and files in every project and opens the exact place.

changes.zh: 需要你确认的计划、已完成或失败的运行会在项目和对话旁标出，浏览器标签上显示待处理的数量。
changes.en: Plans waiting for you and runs that finished or failed are marked beside their project and conversation, with the count in the browser tab.

changes.zh: 科学审阅逐项列出方法、数据与材料、数字核对和局限，每一项都能查看来源；没有证据记录的数字排在最前并标出。
changes.en: Scientific review lists the approach, data and materials, number check and limitations item by item, each with its source; numbers without an evidence record come first and are marked.

changes.zh: 结果下方会给出可以直接追加的后续分析。
changes.en: Results suggest follow-up analyses you can add directly.

changes.zh: 在输入框里选研究技能，或设为项目新对话的默认技能；内置技能可以复制成自己的版本再修改。
changes.en: Pick a research skill in the composer or make it the project's default for new conversations; copy a built-in skill to edit your own version.

changes.zh: 设置里可以写给 Copilot 的长期说明；模型菜单里显示本对话和最近一次分析的用量。
changes.en: Settings take standing instructions for Copilot; the model menu shows usage for this conversation and the latest analysis.

changes.zh: 可以下载一项研究的回放，发给导师或合作者：问题、计划、结果和汇总图表，只含汇总数据；有少于 20 人的分组时不会生成。
changes.en: Download a study's replay to send to a supervisor or co-author: question, plan, results and aggregate figures only; it is not made when a group has fewer than 20 patients.

changes.zh: 每次运行和每段对话都能查看发送给模型的记录：用途、服务商、内容类型和大小，不显示发出的原文。
changes.en: Every run and conversation shows what was sent to the model: purpose, provider, kind of content and size, never the text sent.

changes.zh: 运行出问题时可以下载问题报告：只含版本、运行状态和原因代码，不含数据、提示词和对话内容，由你决定是否发给支持人员。
changes.en: When a run goes wrong you can download a problem report with versions, run state and reason codes only, no data, prompts or conversation text, and decide yourself whether to send it.

changes.zh: 数据字典新增“来源表”视图：按数据库查看每张原始表、表中读取的值/单位/时间字段，以及从中读取的全部变量；由其他变量计算的变量列出其输入变量。
changes.en: The data dictionary has a Source tables view: for each database it shows every raw table, the value, unit and time fields read from it, and all variables read from it; a variable computed from other variables lists its inputs.

changes.zh: 生存曲线及其他图表中使用主题色的第一条曲线此前不显示，现已修复。
changes.en: Fixed charts in which the first series, drawn in the theme colour, was not shown, including the first Kaplan–Meier curve.

changes.zh: 队列统计用目录中的变量名和单位代替列代码（如“乳酸 mmol/L”而不是 LACT）；跨库对比的病死率在部分结局缺失时注明已知人数；患者审阅的模块数和可用信号数与数据一致。
changes.en: Cohort statistics names variables by their catalog names and units instead of column codes (Lactate mmol/L, not LACT); a cross-database mortality rate states its known denominator when outcomes are partly missing; Patient review module and signal counts match the data.

changes.zh: 仓库历史已重写，移除了不应公开的文件；此前的 0.1.x 预发布版本已撤回，由本版本取代。
changes.en: The repository history was rewritten to remove files that should not have been published; earlier 0.1.x pre-releases were withdrawn and this release replaces them.
